title: VP Sara impeachment: Defense seeks subpoenas for 4 witnesses on Cale88 issue
summary: The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte has requested subpoenas to four individuals to appear as its next witnesses when the trial resumes on Nov. 19 and 20, Rep. Joel Chua said.

blocks.text: The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte has requested that the impeachment court issue subpoenas to four individuals to appear as its next witnesses when the trial resumes on November 19 and 20, House prosecution panel member Joel Chua said.
The Manila lawmaker did not provide further details.
In its request for subpoenas, the defense identified the prospective witnesses as:

items: Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente of AML Consulting PH, who "will testify on fundamental legal concepts relating to the Anti-Money Laundering Act";

Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo, the Department of Trade and Industry's Undersecretary for Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group, who "will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation's registration with the Board of Investments";

Pilar Marilyn M. Pagayunan, MBA, Director IV of the Center for Food Regulation and Research of the Food and Drug Administration, who "will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation's product registration for its sweetened banana chips;"; and

Rowena G. Mendoza, General Manager III and/or any representative from the Center for International Expositions and Missions (CITEM), who "will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation communications, such as, but not limited to, electronic mail correspondences sent by CITEM to Cale88 and other invitations to the corporation for food expositions."

blocks.text: The defense panel earlier informed the impeachment court that it has eight to 10 witnesses remaining for the trial.
It remains unclear whether the defense panel will add more witnesses in the coming days.
Under the rules of the impeachment court, the defense and prosecution panels are directed to submit witnesses at least five days before the trial if those names are not in the pre-trial order.
Duterte has been impeached for alleged unexplained wealth. Three other articles of impeachment against her have been dropped by the prosecution. — BM, GMA News
